Hi Elena,

Marissa from Privacy here — thanks for the requirements PDF. Summary of answers and attached artifacts below.

1) PII classification:
- We treat any identifier that can be linked to an end-user (email address, full name, phone number, account_id) as PII.
- Session identifiers and derived user signatures are considered \"linkable\" telemetry until pseudonymized.

2) Redaction points: 
- Primary redaction occurs in the edge telemetry proxy before messages reach central ingestion (L7 filter). That proxy strips or replaces configured fields according to a per-customer policy.
- For debugging, a controlled path exists where raw telemetry may be retained for up to 7 days in a separate encrypted debug bucket; access to that bucket is logged and requires an incident justification + 2-person approval.

3) Retention tiers:
- Raw debug retention (if enabled): default 7 days (extendable to 30 days with contract);
- Ingested telemetry for model ops/metrics: 90 days;
- Aggregated/derived metrics: 2 years.

4) Access slicing:
- We offer customer-scoped read-only tokens that only return aggregated results or pseudonymized event streams.
- Exports: export tokens can be scoped to a dataset and time window; long-term export access requires an API key with export permission and is audited.

5) Subprocessors:
- By default: AWS S3 (storage), GCP BigQuery (analytics), Segment (optional pipeline integration).
- Subprocessor access to raw telemetry is restricted; only Redwood platform engineers with approved justification can access the debug bucket.

Artifacts attached/uploaded:
- pii-mapping.csv (column-level mapping showing original field, transform applied, redaction rule)
- dataflow-v2.png (annotated dataflow: edge proxy -> ingestion -> transform -> storage/analytics)
- short FAQ in the Drive folder about export token scopes.

I'll paste a short excerpt from the mapping CSV: 

field_name,example,redaction
email,REDACTED,sha256+pseudonymization
account_id,acct_9x1,retain
ip,192.0.2.10,remove
message_text,partial content,truncate+hash

Let us know if you want the CSV in a different schema. ETA: full bundle live in Drive in ~3 hours.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Elena — a couple of technical details to shore up the SSQ: 

- Redaction location: edge telemetry proxy (Envoy filter chain) performs fast L7 transforms. That means PII fields never reach the central unencrypted stream in routine operation.
- Debug pipeline: when debug retention is enabled, raw payloads are written to an encrypted S3 bucket with SSE-KMS using customer-scoped key material (if configured) or Redwood-managed keys otherwise. Access is via IAM role that is time-limited and logged.
- Subprocessor exposure: analytics jobs in BigQuery operate on pseudonymized datasets; we run a validation job to ensure no raw payload columns are present before query access is granted.
- Sanitized sample: attached sanitized-telemetry-sample.csv — all PII columns replaced with deterministic pseudonyms and data types labeled per your ask.

We can also provide a short workshop (30-45 minutes) to walk your engineering/security review through the proxy rules and show redaction in a replay. Proposed slots: Tue 2028-07-16 10:00 AM PT or Wed 2028-07-17 02:00 PM PT.

Regards,
